title: Illinois mandatory auto liability insurance
facts: Illinois minimum auto liability limits are $25,000 for injury or death of one person, $50,000 for injury or death of more than one person, and $20,000 for property damage.
Liability insurance is required for motor vehicles that must display license plates and are driven in Illinois; trailers are not subject to this requirement.
Illinois electronically verifies insurance coverage for registered vehicles at least twice each year.
A first registration suspension for failure to maintain required liability insurance requires obtaining coverage and paying a $100 reinstatement fee.
